title: Cancel Amazon Prime in India: Steps and Refunds (2026)
metaDescription: How to end Amazon Prime in India, when you get a refund on an annual or monthly plan, how to stop auto-renewal, and how to switch off Amazon Auto Pay and the UPI mandate.
h1: How do I cancel Amazon Prime in India, and will I get a refund?
summary: To end Amazon Prime in India, sign in to amazon.in, open the Amazon Prime membership page and select End membership, then follow the on-screen steps. An annual membership is refunded in full only if you have made no eligible purchases and used no Prime benefits since the latest charge. If you joined through Google Play or a bank or payment app, you must cancel in that service instead.
keywords: turn off Amazon Prime auto renewal
stepsHeading: How to end Amazon Prime on amazon.in

steps.name: Sign in
steps.text: Sign in to your account on amazon.in in a web browser.

steps.name: Open your Prime membership
steps.text: Go to Your Account and open the Amazon Prime membership page, where Amazon's terms say you adjust membership settings.

steps.name: Select End membership
steps.text: On the membership page, choose End membership.

steps.name: Follow the on-screen steps
steps.text: Complete the prompts and note any refund amount or end date shown before you confirm.

steps.name: Switch off Auto Pay
steps.text: In the Amazon app, open the Amazon Pay dashboard, go to Account, then Auto Pay, select Amazon Prime and choose Disable.

sections.heading: Where to cancel: web, Google Play and payment apps
paragraphs: Amazon's help page for ending membership gives one route: the Amazon Prime membership page, End membership, then the on-screen instructions. It does not list separate steps for the Android app, an iPhone or a TV, so use a browser on the device you have.

The place to cancel depends on where you bought the membership. If you signed up through the Android shopping app or the Prime Video Android app using Google Play, you must manage the subscription in Subscriptions on Google Play. Amazon's terms allow a refund through Google Play only if less than 48 hours have passed since the purchase. If you bought it through Bharat Connect or a bank or payment app, manage it in the Subscriptions section of that app, and Amazon's terms say such purchases are not eligible for a refund.

sections.heading: Refunds on annual and monthly plans
paragraphs: For an annual Prime, Prime Lite or Prime Shopping Edition membership, Amazon says it refunds the full fee on cancellation, provided you have made no eligible purchases and used no Prime benefits since your latest membership charge. If you have used a benefit or made an eligible purchase, no refund is given. Otherwise the membership fee is non-refundable.

On a monthly plan, Amazon's recurring-payments terms say that if you cancel before the end of the current plan, you are not entitled to any compensation for the unused period. A prorated refund applies when Amazon itself ends the membership, which it does by issuing a credit note. Prime Lite and Prime Shopping Edition have their own terms, so check the plan you are on before you cancel.

sections.heading: Turning off auto-renewal instead of ending Prime
paragraphs: Turning off auto-renewal is different from ending the membership. Amazon's terms say you can cancel or disable Recurring Payments by contacting customer support or in the settings of your Amazon.in account. Your membership then continues for the rest of the current period and does not renew at the end of it.

Renewal also stops if a recurring payment is declined, for example because a card has expired. If you cancel or disable Recurring Payments during a free trial or promotional period, any unused part of that period lapses and is not available to you.

sections.heading: Switching off Amazon Auto Pay and the UPI mandate
paragraphs: Amazon's UPI help lists Amazon Prime among the categories that support Auto Pay. To switch it off, open the Amazon Pay dashboard in the Amazon app, go to Account, then Auto Pay, choose the category and select Disable or the Pause or Delete option, then confirm.

A UPI mandate is also recorded in your UPI app, so after the Amazon steps check the AutoPay or Mandates section there. The label can differ by app version. NPCI's UPI Help portal at upihelp.npci.org.in is the other place to look up mandates. Amazon's UPI help also says that for third-party services you should check the merchant's own platform to confirm the payment status.

sections.heading: Keeping Prime renewals in view
paragraphs: Prime renews on a different date from most monthly plans, so it is easy to miss when it comes round. Adding it to Essara as a subscription, with its renewal date and what it costs over a year, lets you see it next to your other plans before it renews. Essara works manually: you enter the membership yourself, and it does not connect to your bank, UPI app or SMS.

faqs.q: Does turning off auto-renewal end my Prime membership?
faqs.a: No. Amazon's terms say the membership continues for the rest of the current period and does not renew afterwards. To end it straight away, use End membership on the Amazon Prime membership page.

faqs.q: Can I get a refund on a monthly Prime plan?
faqs.a: Amazon's recurring-payments terms say there is no compensation for the unused part of a plan if you cancel early. The full-refund rule in the Prime terms applies to annual memberships, and only if you have made no eligible purchases and used no Prime benefits since the latest charge.

faqs.q: Why must I cancel Prime through Google Play?
faqs.a: Amazon's terms say that if you signed up through the Android shopping app or Prime Video Android app using Google Play, you must manage the subscription in Subscriptions on Google Play. A refund through Google Play is possible only if less than 48 hours have passed since the purchase.

faqs.q: Will Amazon keep charging me through UPI after I end Prime?
faqs.a: Check both places. Disable Auto Pay for Amazon Prime in the Amazon app, then look for the mandate in your UPI app's AutoPay or Mandates section and revoke it there if it is still active.

faqs.q: What if I bought Prime through Bharat Connect or a bank app?
faqs.a: Amazon's terms say you must manage the subscription through the payment app or banking platform you bought it from. Membership bought that way is not eligible for a refund, so cancel it there to stop renewals.
